title: Method for quantifying local bone changes
search_theme: longitudinal registration / bone change quantification / graft resorption
claim1_summary: Load first and second CT volumes; register to one coordinate system; select ROI by anatomical landmarks defining clipping planes; segment air/soft tissue in ROI as outside region; compute local bone volume in each; subtract to give local bone change.
relevance_to_osteoquant: High: closest claim found to registering post-op and follow-up scans and quantifying volume change in an ROI (dental graft site context).
notes: Expiry shown 2032-02-06. Claim 1 requires landmark-defined clipping-plane ROI and total local-bone subtraction; OsteoQuant uses auto-detected cylinder ROI and per-class propagation. Attorney to compare element-by-element before shipping longitudinal module, esp. any landmark/box ROI option.
